resolved_note: Original ontology referenced 'Creates Need: NEED_PERSISTENCE', which was never a defined Core Need. Removed rather than invented — Persistence is a behavior/trait (TRAIT_PERSISTENT), not a Need. Resolves instead to NEED_COMPETENCE, NEED_AUTONOMY, or NEED_CONFIDENCE depending on story context.

note: Broadened to cover Self-Doubt, Anger, Jealousy, Impatience, Embarrassment, Guilt, Worry, Perfectionism as one shared function. Fear stays separate (see OBSTACLE_FEAR) because it's actively referenced by LOGIC_SAFETY_LOOP's selection criteria.
7 of 8 Time-domain obstacles were previously misfiled under OBSTACLE_DISTRACTION, a mechanically different concept (attention-pulled-away vs. deadline-approaching).
